## Overview
Rakebig Services (https://www.rakebig.com) is an engineering and AI automation agency. We design, build, customize, and support Perfex CRM systems, SaaS platforms, web applications (Laravel/Vue), mobile applications (Flutter), and practical AI workflow automations for growing companies worldwide.

## Core Capabilities & Services

1. Perfex CRM Solutions (https://www.rakebig.com/services/perfex-crm-solutions)
   - Custom module development, tenant management, workflow automation, and multi-tenant SaaS for Perfex CRM.

2. SaaS Platform Development (https://www.rakebig.com/services/saas-platform-development)
   - Multi-tenant software architecture, subscription management, tenant isolation, and billing portals.

3. Web Application Development (https://www.rakebig.com/services/web-application-development)
   - High-performance web applications, client portals, and administrative dashboards on Laravel and Vue.js.

4. Mobile App Development (https://www.rakebig.com/services/mobile-app-development)
   - Production cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android built with Flutter, integrated directly with backend CRMs and REST APIs.

5. App Clone Development (https://www.rakebig.com/services/app-clone-development)
   - On-demand marketplace, delivery (Zepto/Blinkit/Swiggy), chat, and social applications engineered for scale.

6. App Publish Solution (https://www.rakebig.com/services/app-publish-solution)
   - Google Play Store & Apple App Store compliance, automated build pipelines, and publishing assistance.

7. AI Business Automation (https://www.rakebig.com/services/ai-business-automation)
   - Practical AI workflows, automated lead routing, ticket triage, document extraction, and custom AI agents.

8. Business Integrations (https://www.rakebig.com/services/business-integrations)
   - WhatsApp Cloud API, VoIP / IP telephony, Razorpay/Stripe payment gateways, and custom webhook workflows.

9. Cloud Deployment & DevOps (https://www.rakebig.com/services/cloud-deployment-devops)
   - Docker containerization, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), aaPanel, Coolify, VPS setup, SSL, and cloud management.

10. Maintenance & Support (https://www.rakebig.com/services/maintenance-support)
    - 24x7 monitoring, SLA-backed bug fixes, security patches, and database optimization.

11. Dedicated Team (https://www.rakebig.com/services/dedicated-team)
    - Full-stack engineers, UI/UX designers, and DevOps leads embedded into client engineering squads.

12. IT Consulting (https://www.rakebig.com/services/it-consulting)
    - Architectural reviews, tech audits, security compliance, and technology roadmaps.

   - Hyperlocal quick-commerce super-app for groceries, electronics, and multi-hub dark-store inventory pooling.

3. Food App Clone (https://www.rakebig.com/clones/food-app-clone)
   - Swiggy and Zomato-style multi-restaurant food delivery marketplace with live kitchen POS tablets and rider routing.

4. Taxi App Clone (https://www.rakebig.com/clones/taxi-app-clone)
   - Uber and Ola-style on-demand ride-hailing with upfront fares, driver radar broadcast, SOS, and fleet management.

5. On-Demand Services Clone (https://www.rakebig.com/clones/on-demand-services-clone)
   - Urban Company-style home repairs, cleaning, salon, and professional services booking with slot calendars and OTP verification.

6. WhatsApp Clone (https://www.rakebig.com/clones/whatsapp-clone)
   - Signal-protocol end-to-end encrypted messaging, WebRTC voice/video calls, status stories, and multi-device sync.

7. TikTok Clone (https://www.rakebig.com/clones/tiktok-clone)
   - Short-video discovery app with algorithmic For You feed, in-app video recording studio, audio track library, and live gifting.

8. Dating App Clone (https://www.rakebig.com/clones/dating-app-clone)
   - Tinder and Bumble-style swipe matching, geolocation radius discovery, AI selfie verification, and VIP subscriptions.

9. Streaming App Clone (https://www.rakebig.com/clones/streaming-app-clone)
   - Netflix and YouTube-style OTT video-on-demand and live broadcasting with adaptive bitrate HLS and DRM protection.

10. Video Conferencing Clone (https://www.rakebig.com/clones/video-conferencing-clone)
    - Zoom and Google Meet-style WebRTC SFU video meetings with HD screen sharing, cloud recording, and waiting rooms.

3. Zero-Downtime Server Migrations (https://www.rakebig.com/open-source/server-migrations)
   - Safe migration of databases, multi-TB file assets, and services across cloud providers with zero downtime and rollbacks.

4. SecOps & AIOps (https://www.rakebig.com/open-source/secops-aiops)

5. 24/7 Managed Maintenance & Support (https://www.rakebig.com/open-source/managed-maintenance)
   - Proactive security patching, database optimization, encrypted backup verification, and 15-minute incident response SLA.

6. Nextcloud Enterprise (https://www.rakebig.com/open-source/nextcloud)
   - Self-hosted alternative to Google Drive & Dropbox with OnlyOffice/Collabora suite, end-to-end encryption, and file syncing.

7. Rocket.Chat Enterprise (https://www.rakebig.com/open-source/rocket-chat)
   - Air-gapped self-hosted team communication, omnichannel live website chat widgets, matrix federation, and regulatory compliance.

8. Mattermost DevOps Collaboration (https://www.rakebig.com/open-source/mattermost)
   - High-trust developer chat, incident playbooks, Git CI/CD toolchain integrations, and air-gapped security for tech teams.

9. Jitsi Meet & Video Matrix (https://www.rakebig.com/open-source/jitsi-meet)
   - Unlimited HD WebRTC video conferencing, private room token authentication, SIP telephony bridge, and Matrix messaging federation.

10. Coolify & aaPanel PaaS (https://www.rakebig.com/open-source/coolify-aapanel)
    - Self-hosted Heroku and cPanel alternative for automated Git push-to-deploy, Docker container management, and Nginx reverse proxies.
